scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n be,fe -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:dev -w @pop-quiz/backend" "npm start -w @pop-quiz/frontend"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n be,fe -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:dev -w @pop-quiz/backend" "npm run start:lan -w @pop-quiz/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pop-quiz/backend && npm run build -w @pop-quiz/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @pop-quiz/shared && npm test -w @pop-quiz/backend && npm run test:ci -w @pop-quiz/frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @pop-quiz/backend
